decision.reasoning_trace: I am searching for a Bluetooth speaker that balances sound quality, durability, and value. My consideration set included high-end home audio (Edifier S350DB), premium multi-room options (Audio Pro Addon C10 MKII), and several portable choices like the JBL Charge 4, INSMY, and Altec Lansing. The high-end units are impressively reviewed but exceed my budget. The JBL Charge 4 is a great mid-tier option, but I am hesitant about it being a renewed item. The budget-friendly INSMY and Altec Lansing speakers seem durable but likely lack the audio richness I desire. Without a clear winner that hits all my criteria, I've decided not to purchase anything from this list.
